verdict.rationale: LogQL and Loki docs (grafana-docs-15) show label-based filtering without predefined indexes, and ad-hoc/dynamic drilldown plus preserved label filters (grafana-gh-1, grafana-gh-2, grafana-gh-5) support exploring by arbitrary fields like user id or request id; Grafana's multi-datasource query/alerting layer (grafana-docs-25) reinforces flexible grouping across data. However, the pack lacks explicit evidence about high-cardinality performance guarantees, trace/span-level filtering by arbitrary IDs (e.g., Tempo TraceQL specifics), or benchmarks proving no pre-aggregation/indexing is needed at scale. missing for 10: explicit high-cardinality performance/architecture docs (e.g., TraceQL or Loki index-free querying at scale), independent hands-on benchmarks confirming ad-hoc grouping by user/request id without schema setup.
